name: Way Big
abilities: Cosmic ray fired from crossed arms (can disintegrate a small planet)
Planetary-class strength (threw a giant Vilgax into orbit, lifted the Hyperspace Jump Gate)
Enhanced speed (vortex that hurled the Trash Monster into the sun)
weaknesses: Head frill is his critical weak point - a hit there stuns him
Size causes clumsiness and collateral damage
Tiny attackers (Nanomech) can get inside him
Sedative quills or Corrupturas can subdue him
summary: Ben's 100-foot To'kustar giant: an Ultraman-style titan whose crossed-arm cosmic ray and sheer mass made him Ben's strongest alien before Alien X.
traits: To'kustars have no home planet - they are born in cosmic storms
First appeared used by Ben 10,000 in Ken 10
Considered Ben's most powerful alien pre-Alien X
Has an Ultimate form (Ultimate Way Big)
notableFeats: Destroyed Vilgax's army and threw Vilgax into space (Ben 10: Secret of the Omnitrix)
Defeated a giant Vilgax on Primus (Primus)
Threw the Trash Monster into the sun with a vortex (The Widening Gyre)
Fought Malware and the Way Bads, destroying Milleous's ship (Showdown: Part 2 / The Frogs of War: Part 2)
Went Ultimate against Dagon (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: White body with red arms bearing three black stripes, red feet with black sandal-like coverings, head frill black in front and red beneath, shoulder blades and waist spikes, yellow eyes with two extra cheek eyes, Omnitrix on chest. Ben 10,000's version is near-identical.

Slightly bigger; frill red in front and black beneath, white arms with red fins, black neck and wrists, green eyes, no cheek eyes, arm stripes, shoulder blades or waist spikes; red boot-like feet; Omnitrix on chest (shared AF/UA design).
Same UAF design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix on his chest; cosmic ray fired in an 'L' arm cross and coloured pale blue.

appearances.firstEpisode: Blukic and Driba Go to Mr. Smoothy's
notableEpisodes: Blukic and Driba Go to Mr. Smoothy's
appearances.designNotes: More muscular, two red neck lines, red shoulder/waist blades return, black fingerless gloves, cheek eyes back (metallic), longer arm fins, arm/leg stripes and wristband growths return; cosmic ray fired in an 'X' cross and coloured green. 16/11-year-old share the design; Omnitrix ring white (16) or silver (11).

scoring.rationale: Planet-scale strength and a cosmic ray that can disintegrate a small planet put him at the top of the roster; he shrugs off giant Vilgax, Malware and Way Bads. His frill is a glaring weak point, tiny foes get inside him, and his size makes him unusable in cities.

notes: Wiki lists first appearance as Ken 10 (by Ben 10,000); by air date Secret of the Omnitrix (Aug 2007) was the first release and Ben's own first use - debut usedBy follows the wiki (ben-10k-os).
Homeworld left blank: To'kustars have no home planet (born in cosmic storms).
AF: War of the Worlds: Part 1 is wiki S1 (Ben 15); Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2, Simple, Primus are wiki S2 (Ben 16).
Also used by Kevin (Inspector 13, via Ultimatrix), Azmuth as Evil Way Big (Destroy All Aliens) and Mad Ben (OV) - not counted.
